name: phone-frame
title: phone-frame
description: A screenshot of a phone app held in a phone's dark rounded body, the picture at its own height. Owns its full style; size it via the Ref's style (width).

definition.name: phone-frame
definition.description: A screenshot of a phone app held in a phone's dark rounded body, the picture at its own height. Owns its full style; size it via the Ref's style (width).
definition.whenToUse: Show a phone app's screen as the phone itself, on a slide or a page, from a screenshot that already carries the phone's status bar. Compose via a Ref, mapping src/alt to host fields; set width on the Ref's style.
